svg.title: Labelled all-inclusive package versus do-it-yourself Cancun week
svg.desc: Two adults, seven nights, labelled sketch in Canadian dollars. Package door to door about 2590 dollars including a tip sketch. Do-it-yourself with restaurant-level food about 2880 dollars. The same DIY stack with simpler food and a cheaper flight can fall near 2355 dollars.
svg.text: Same week, three totals, before travel medical
Two adults, 7 nights. Labelled sketch. Placeholder FX 1.36 CAD per USD for tips only.
Package wins in the first DIY stack. It loses when you will not drink the included alcohol
and the cash flights are actually on sale. Medical insurance is a separate Insurance decision.
Do not deposit until both columns use the same dates and the same party.
Illustrative Canadian-origin week. Not a live package. Re-price before you pay a deposit.
